governance_rationale: No authentic, non-synthetic supervised training dataset exists for candidate-to-occupation skill gap classification. Creating artificial negative pairs or synthetic gap labels would violate strict ML data integrity rules. In accordance with Section 8 instructions, the system deploys BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (pretrained 384-dimensional dense semantic embeddings) and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-4bit for genuine zero-shot inference, explicitly disclosing that supervised fine-tuning was omitted to preserve scientific rigor.
